chk_import_run_trigger_consistency.name: chk_import_run_trigger_consistency
chk_import_run_trigger_consistency.value:
("import_run"."trigger_kind" = 'admin' AND "import_run"."triggered_by_admin_id" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("import_run"."trigger_kind" = 'cron' AND "import_run"."triggered_by_admin_id" IS NULL)

chk_game_mode_matches_daily_challenge.name: chk_game_mode_matches_daily_challenge
chk_game_mode_matches_daily_challenge.value:
("game"."mode" = 'daily' AND "game"."daily_challenge_id" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("game"."mode" = 'freeplay' AND "game"."daily_challenge_id" IS NULL)
